document.heading: First Americans Museum Authorization Act

history.narrative: Posted on Kiowa Tribe Website: June 10, 2024. Read into Record by: Alana Quetone, District 4 – Legislative Session LXXXVI-(86), June 08, 2024. Legislative Regular Session LXXXVII-(87), July 13, 2024. Legislative Regular Session LXXXVIII-(88), August 10, 2024. Sponsor Michael Primus, District 2: Legislative Public Hearing VII, September 11, 2024. Legislative Regular Session LXXXIX-(89), September 14, 2024.

document.text: At a duly called Legislative Regular Session LXXXIX of the Legislature of the Kiowa Tribe held this 14th day of September, 2024, the following resolution, was adopted.

recital.text: the Kiowa Tribe of Oklahoma is a federally recognized Indian Tribe with a Constitution approved by the Secretary of the Interior; and,

the Chairman of the Kiowa Tribe, is authorized and empowered pursuant to Article VII, Section 4(c) of the Constitution of the Kiowa Tribe to negotiate contracts on behalf of the Kiowa Tribe subject to authorization and approval of the Legislature; and,
the Legislature, is vested with the authority to pass laws and resolutions pursuant to Article VI, Section 6 (a) of the Constitution of the Kiowa Tribe; and,
this Resolution shall be known as the "First Americans Museum Authorization Act"; and,

the Chairman of the Kiowa Tribe has been approached by the First Americans Museum Foundation regarding a Repository License Agreement for the use of certain classroom materials belonging to the Kiowa Tribe as a part of its repository, a form copy of which is attached hereto; and

the Kiowa Tribe Legislature, having been delegated certain authorities under the Kiowa Constitution, the governing body of the Kiowa Tribe, does hereby authorize the Chairman of the Kiowa Tribe to negotiate and sign the Repository License Agreement with the First Americans Museum Foundation.

procedural-data.text: The foregoing Resolution KL-CY-2024-017 was duly voted upon by the Legislature on September 14, 2024, at a Legislative Regular Session LXXXIX-(89), with a vote of (6) in favor and (0) opposed, (0) abstaining, and (0) absent, according to the authority vested in the Legislature by the Constitution of the Kiowa Tribe.

text.b: DELIVERY OF THE RESOLUTION AND LAW TO THE CHAIRMAN

procedural-data.text: Resolution No. KL-CY-2024-017 was presented to the Chairman of the Kiowa Tribe on the 30th day of September, 2024, pursuant to the Article VI, Section 8(a)(iv) of the Constitution of the Kiowa Tribe, and will become effective after signature by the Chairman or veto override by the Legislature, and as otherwise required by the Constitution.
